meta.title: UK RALP Surgical Outcomes Database v2 - System Architecture

views.label: Primary request & cache path
views.note: Follow an authenticated clinician request through Next.js middleware and in-memory cache to Supabase PostgreSQL.

views.label: Role boundaries & Caldicott governance
views.note: Three distinct user portals isolated by Next.js edge route guards and PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS).

views.label: Intelligent document ingestion pipeline
views.note: Uploaded pathology PDFs and theatre DOCX notes pass through Mammoth.js & NLP extraction before validated commit.

cards.title: Client & App Tier (ARCHITECTURE.md ?3.1)
items: Next.js 15 App Router with React 19 and Server Actions
Clinician Command Center: 4-Tab Dossier, Overdue Queues, Pentafecta Analytics
Patient PROMs Portal: IPSS, SHIM/IIEF-5, and 24h Continence tracking
Admin Console: User provisioning, NPCA completeness checks, CSV export

cards.title: Security & Caldicott P7 (ARCHITECTURE.md ?7)
items: Supabase Auth with JWT in secure HttpOnly cookies refreshed on every request
PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) restricts access by clinical role
Append-only immutable audit trail with SECURITY DEFINER actor identity locking
Automated pseudonymization of NHS and Hospital numbers for research exports

cards.title: Data & Performance Tier (ARCHITECTURE.md ?4 & ADR-001)
items: Supabase PostgreSQL 15+ with pg_trgm for sub-millisecond search
In-Memory LRU Cache delivers <5ms response for clinical registry queries
Computed DB triggers: ISUP Grade Group, Biochemical Recurrence (PSA >= 0.2)
Supabase S3-compatible encrypted object storage for original PDFs/DOCX

cards.title: Intelligent Ingestion (ARCHITECTURE.md ?3.2.1)
items: Mammoth.js converts Microsoft Word theatre notes into structured text
Automated NLP extraction of pT stage, margins (R0/R1), EPE, and SVI
Deterministic fuzzy matching links uploaded documents to patient MRNs
Review Queue with mandatory clinical justification for discrepancy overrides
